messages.subject: updating old packages
parts:
Hi Henrik and everyone,
I just now realized that to really update everything you need to open a
'fresh' session of R (e.g. vanilla) -- or at least I think so. When I
started up my previous R session, R.utils and similar such packages
automatically loaded as well, so then they wouldn't update because they
were in use. This is unlike my usual experience in R (where a package
wouldn't be load unless explicitly called) so I thought I'd mention it.
Best,
Elizabeth
